GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, railed up rounding turn and in straight, held up on heels 220m-75m. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME) # no luck in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Held up for clear running between the 250m and 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then slow into stride and Settled Down last 8 Lengths from the lead, railed to 6 Lengths turning, hugged fence rounding turn then Made Ground along fence in straight. (Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # never left fence
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Made contact with rail round turn near the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th 4 Lengths enjoyed good trail To The Turn asked to go at the 400m, couldn't quicken - # Just Battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 250m, raced in restricted room & obliged to alter course.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back Restrained from Outside Settled Down rear Outside 9 Lengths 3 Wide with a trail x 600m clear run home Never Likely but Kept Finding Closest on the line, # Did Best Work Late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide for the majority. Approaching the line, became awkwardly placed at heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, Held Ground in straight. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME) # midfield throughout
Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down last 8 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # never featured

Away evenly. Niggled early & raced @ rear on inside (6L from lead). Pushed to stay in touch with bunch midrace & pressured Two Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Held ground Two Wide in straight. # Fair 1st-up run.
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6 Lengths 2-3 wide, little change to turn then forced wider to 5.5 Lengths 3-4 wide, Lost Ground in Straight # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide for the majority. Forced wider near the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, little change to 4.5 Lengths rail turning, lost a length down the running # midfield throughout
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Passing the 400m, momentarily steadied when awkwardly placed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 Lengths not bustled, settled 4-5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and gave ground late # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start and lost ground. Raced keenly in the middle stages.
